records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with zero product progress: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to either outreach email (email:ff1bb5e0, email:01b8fb71). No tickets means no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, 8 days left. Silent accounts with no activity by day 6 rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Just checking in since signup. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so setting up your first one is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Silver Logistics works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
